clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard answers Sara Balloo's plea with a lasting tribute to Sully, her fallen husband. He sends you to relay his royal commission to Grand Mason Marblesten.

King Magni Bronzebeard hears Sara Balloo's plea and gives the grieving widow his attention. He knows common folk may struggle to understand the harsh needs of war, yet every soldier who fights beneath the Alliance banner weighs on his conscience. Magni cannot undo a death on the front lines. He can make sure Sully Balloo's sacrifice is remembered.

King Magni chooses a stone memorial for Sully instead of empty words. He appoints you custodian of his royal will and sends you across Ironforge to Grand Mason Marblesten. The master stonemason receives the King's personal commission and prepares to carve the memory of a fallen defender into stone.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I do not expect good dwarves like Mrs. Balloo to understand why the travesties of war must be endured for the greater good of our people. The loss of her husband, and the loss of every dwarf that fights in the name of the Alliance, weighs heavy on my soul.
While I cannot bring her husband back from the Twisting Nether, I can pay tribute to him.
I am going to commission a memorial to Sully Balloo to be built by Grand Mason Mablesten.
Send word to him now, adventurer. You shall be custodian of my bidding.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So King Magni Bronzebeard himself sent ye?
My, my! This must be important!
